expand_link.description: Read the address a clck.ru short link opens, without opening it. Nothing is fetched from the far side and no visit is recorded there, so this is safe to run on a link somebody sent you, and it answers just as quickly for a destination that is slow or gone. No account or API key required.
expand_link.display_name: Check where a short link goes
expand_link.name: expand_link

parameters.description: The clck.ru link to look up. Paste the whole link, or just the code on the end of it. Capitals matter: 3WX4dV and 3wx4dv are different links.
parameters.name: short_url

original_url.description: The address the short link opens. This is the long link somebody shortened, not the Yandex safety check visitors pass through on the way.

short_url.description: The short link, e.g. https://clck.ru/3WX4dV. Paste this wherever the long one would have gone.

shorten_link.description: Turn a long web address into a short clck.ru link to paste into a text message, a post, an invoice or anywhere else the whole address would not fit. The same link always gives the same short link, so a workflow that runs again reuses the one it made rather than piling up new ones. No account or API key required.
shorten_link.name: shorten_link

parameters.description: The web address to shorten. Paste it exactly as it appears in the address bar, however long or untidy: question marks, ampersands and tracking parameters are all fine and nothing needs escaping. Up to 4,096 characters.
parameters.name: url

already_short.description: True when the link was already a short link (a clck.ru one, or one from another shortener such as bit.ly), so it was kept as it was rather than shortened again.

original_url.description: The long link, as it was given. An address typed without https:// comes back with it added, so this is exactly what the short link opens.

short_url.description: The short link, e.g. https://clck.ru/3WX4dV. Paste this wherever the long one would have gone.

shorten_links.description: Shorten a whole list of links in one step, and get one result for each, in the order you gave them. A link clck.ru will not take is reported beside the rest with the reason instead of stopping the run, so one bad address in a column of fifty does not cost you the other forty nine. No account or API key required.

shorten_links.name: shorten_links

parameters.description: The links to shorten. Use a list from an earlier step, such as a column of a spreadsheet, or paste the links in with one on each line. Up to 50 at a time; a full list takes about half a minute.
parameters.name: urls

shorten_links_in_text.description: Hand over a message and get it back with every link in it replaced by a short one and nothing else touched. This is the step to put before a text message, a post or a chat notification goes out, and it counts the characters so the next step can check the message still fits. A link clck.ru will not take is left where it is, so a message never goes out with a hole in it. No account or API key required.

description: Shorten links with clck.ru, Yandex's free link shortener. Shorten one link, a whole list of them, or every link inside a message, and check where a short link goes before you trust it. Links are sent exactly as you paste them, however long or untidy, and the same link always gives back the same short link, so a workflow that runs every day reuses its links instead of making new ones. No account or API key required.
